description: This file contains CSS styles for the Tic Tac Toe web game's frontend, focusing on theme management and responsive design.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container class for the web application, applying background color, text color, and layout properties.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Class for the logo of the application, controlling size and animation properties.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the header section of the application, managing layout and background color.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links within the application, focusing on color and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button class used for toggling themes between light and dark modes, with responsive design features.
